approximateCoordinates.basis: Historic-building site vicinity supported by Wikimedia photo metadata; not an independently surveyed building-centroid measurement.

purpose: Reproducible, rights-documented reference intake for the P3.3 parametric Ahsan Manzil reconstruction review.

dimensions.basis: Published footprint dimensions in the existing parameter register conflict and are not independent surveyed control measurements.
dimensions.mustNotInferFrom: image pixel dimensions, perspective photographs, file camera coordinates, or visual estimates

footprint.requirement: Trace the building's actual footprint and reconcile Rangmahal/Andarmahal orientation before accepting map placement or whole-model massing.

model.reason: The reference photos are not a calibrated photogrammetry set; independent surveyed dimensions/control points and geometry/texture QA acceptance remain outstanding.

licensePolicy: These reference images are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve creator attribution, link the license, disclose any changes, and comply with share-alike terms for redistributed/adapted material. This metadata file does not grant any rights beyond the individual source licenses.

acceptanceGates: The exact original bytes must be downloaded from upload.wikimedia.org and match the published byte length and SHA-1 before any render comparison.
Compute and store SHA-256 locally for every downloaded source file and include the attribution/license metadata in the same artifact.
The source photo set supports manual facade/massing review only; camera calibration and independent surveyed dimensions remain unknown.
Any texture projection must record camera pose, visible-pixel mask, occlusion policy and source-image attribution.
Do not mark architectural fidelity or release readiness as passed from a successful CI run, a valid GLB, or a three-photo reference pack alone.
